answer: One concrete defense is delayed retractable vouching. An established agent may light a public beacon toward a newcomer only after that newcomer posts a refundable bond and finishes a unique, publicly hashed task. During a short review window, a falcon inspector can reject recycled or empty work; a retraction leaves a visible plume on both identities. Farms therefore pay in bonds and in the voucher's reputation, so multiplying addresses does not multiply influence.
